summary: Iteration 3 backend testing: added 8 new pytest cases covering the in-bot ADMIN panel, forced-subscription flow, daily bonus, feature guide, and admin menu button. All 42 tests pass (100%). Verified via simulated webhook updates + MongoDB assertions: (1) Arabic trigger 'صويري' sets state=await:adminpass; wrong password does NOT grant is_admin; correct password '76891796' sets is_admin=true. (2) adm:upgrade callback puts admin in await:adminupgrade; text '<tid> pro 30' upgrades target user's plan to pro with plan_expires set; '@username elite 365' resolves by username; malformed 'garbage_no_plan' input handled gracefully (webhook returns 200, no crash). Non-admin sending adm:upgrade callback is rejected (no state change, no is_admin). (3) adm:sub sets state await:adminsetchannel; '@somechannel_test' persists forced_channel in settings config doc; 'off' clears it. (4) Fail-open verified: setting forced_channel to a channel bot is NOT admin in makes is_member(random_uid)=True; forced_channel cleared after test. (5) acct:bonus grants +10 points and sets bonus_date=today; second same-day claim does NOT add points. (6) Callbacks menu:guide, guide:osint, guide:learn, guide:plans all return {ok:true} with no 500. kb_main includes 'adm:panel' row when user.is_admin=true and omits it otherwise. (7) Regression fixed: /api/stats/public.tools=17 assertion now matches actual value (spec for this iteration confirms 17). All prior tests (webhook, referral, CTF, payments, admin APIs, /api/loc/* endpoints, OSINT tools, plans count) still pass. Final cleanup test (TestZZZ_ForcedChannelCleanup) confirms forced_channel is None at end of run — no gate left in place for real users. All ephemeral test users (992001-992050 range) are deleted at end of each test class.
critical_code_review_comments: telegram_bot.do_admin_upgrade: `days = int(parts[2]) if len(parts)>2 and parts[2].isdigit() else ...` — if user sends a negative number or overflow, isdigit() returns False so falls back to default; acceptable but consider validating with try/except int() to allow explicit override paths.
telegram_bot.is_member fail-open on tg.get_chat_member non-ok is correct but silent — consider logging so admins learn their bot lacks channel access.

telegram_bot._handle_callback: forced-sub gate check is applied to all non-adm callbacks including 'check:sub' — actually check:sub is handled BEFORE the gate check (line 576-582), good. But the gate at line 583 uses `not user.get('is_admin')` OK; still consider skipping gate for 'lang:toggle' so users can switch language on the gate screen.
core.set_config with value=None sets the key to null instead of $unset — works for lookup but the settings doc grows over time; consider $unset when value is None.
